100511.title: Wheel lacing overview
guidance: Collect and visually inspect 1 EA HL Hub (Product Number HU-8998), 1 EA HL Road Rim (Product Number RM-R800), 36 EA Spokes (Product Number SK-9283), and 36 EA HL Nipple (Product Number NI-9522).

In an assumed wheel assembly stand, arrange the hub centrally within the rim. Fit the spokes between hub and rim and engage a nipple at each rim end; the lacing shown in illustration 100511 is schematic, not a specified pattern.

100512.title: Tire and reflector placement
guidance: Fit 1 EA Road Tire Tube (Product Number TT-R982) inside 1 EA HL Road Tire (Product Number TI-R982) and fit them to the rim without visibly pinching the tube.
Fit 2 EA Reflector (Product Number RF-9198) to the spokes in illustrative positions, following the components' supplied mounting directions.
